timeline.title: Lawmakers and Canada Reject Trump's Renaming of Lake Ontario Amid Trade Tensions
timeline.summary: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America'. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded by stating that the lake will continue to be called Lake Ontario, emphasizing that its name will remain unchanged. This order follows recent tensions between the US and Canada, including the collapse of trade talks and the announcement of reciprocal tariffs.
key_facts: Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America'.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated the name will remain Lake Ontario.
The order follows collapsed U.S.-Canada trade talks and new tariffs.
